defmodule Shop.Accounts do
  alias Shop.{Repo, Token}

  def deliver(user) do
    token = Token.build(user, "login")
    Repo.insert!(token)
    Shop.Mailer.send_login(user, token)
  end

  def update(user, attrs) do
    user
    |> Token.changeset(attrs)
    |> save_and_clear()
  end

  def normalize_all(emails) do
    Enum.map(emails, &normalize/1)
  end

  def admit(email, ip, server \\ __MODULE__)

  def admit(email, ip, server) when is_binary(email) do
    normalized = Token.normalize(email)

    if :inet.is_ip_address(ip) do
      GenServer.call(server, {:admit, normalized})
    else
      {:error, :invalid}
    end
  end

  def handle(:count, state) do
    {:reply, :ets.info(state.table, :size), state}
  end

  def handle({:admit, keys}, state) do
    entries = Enum.map(keys, &entry(state, &1))

    case Enum.find(entries, fn {_key, count} -> count > 3 end) do
      nil -> {:reply, :ok, state}
      _hit -> {:reply, limited(state), state}
    end
  end

  def version, do: 1

  defp save_and_clear(changeset) do
    row = Repo.insert!(changeset)
    Repo.delete!(row)
    row
  end

  defp normalize(email), do: Token.normalize(email)
  defp entry(state, key), do: {key, Map.get(state, key, 0)}
  defp limited(_state), do: {:error, :limited}

  def deliver(user, opts) do
    Token.verify({user, opts})
  end

  def admit(email), do: Token.verify(email)
end
